eq03.plain: In the CES world the ability-controlled interaction is positive (0.002) and the CES fit beats Cobb-Douglas on RMSE (0.376 vs 0.558); in the linear null world the controlled interaction is near zero (0.004). This is a demonstration about estimators, not evidence about any school system.

eq04.plain: A score bar admits rich pupils at a higher rate (gap 0.547); a reserved quota flips the gap (0.091) by construction, and a contest in which richer pupils invest more effort widens it further (0.761). The quota changes who is admitted, not how much anyone learns — this is a rationing demonstration, not an evaluation of any admissions policy.

eq06.plain: Education raises the migration probability in every specification (marginal effect range 0.0089-0.0140) and migrants are more educated than stayers; networks increase the effect. MASSENG v5 does not model rural-urban migration, so this is a synthetic demonstration of the equation, not a model output.
